title: Implement KHOSAN Human Engine v0.1 with Native WebGPU Human Lab
objective: Provide a runnable Native WebGPU parametric-human foundation with a stable Character DNA contract, semantic body/face controls, a live Human Lab preview, and a canonical mesh morph+skinning compute kernel.
acceptance_criteria: Human Lab uses Native WebGPU without third-party rendering engines
Character DNA v1 has stable semantic body, face, appearance and lighting fields
Body/face/appearance controls update the live viewport deterministically
DNA can be exported as JSON
WebGPU compute kernel exists for dense morph evaluation plus normalized four-joint linear blend skinning
Preview and canonical-mesh compute paths remain architecturally separate
Unsupported WebGPU devices fail with an explicit user-visible message
Source verification requires Human Engine files
Browser/GPU acceptance evidence is recorded before status becomes accepted
risks: Procedural SDF viewport is a preview/reference backend, not final anatomical production topology
Canonical human mesh and statistical morph basis are not yet authored
Garment auto-fit and cloth simulation are not yet connected
Runtime performance is not yet accepted on mobile targets
notes: Source implementation is pushed for verification. No claim of production anatomical accuracy until canonical mesh fixtures and deformation QA are completed.
